title: Rabbi Avunah Ze’ira

paragraphs: Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 4:2 relates that they saw him running after a donkey on Shabbat (because gentiles had coerced him). Hyman gives the reading R’ Buna Ze’ira in Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 3:4.[^1]

notes.text: The actual Sheviit 4:2 paragraph names Rabbi Avuna Zeira. The corresponding donkey episode in the current digital Sanhedrin chapter 3, halakhah 5, paragraph 10 has Rabbi Bina Zeira, whereas Hyman supplies Buna Zeira at 3:4. His locator and name are retained with this difference disclosed; the coercion explanation remains Hyman’s.
